title: Recording: Peggy Sue, Ain’t That A Shame, Medley: Bring It On Home To Me/Send Me Some Lovin’, Do You Wanna Dance? by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon recorded several songs for his Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 22 October 1974.

This was the first recording session involving the whole band of session musicians since Lennon relocated the sessions to New York City. They taped the backing tracks for ‘Peggy Sue’, ‘Ain’t That A Shame’, ‘Medley: Bring It On Home To Me/Send Me Some Lovin”, and ‘Do You Wanna Dance?’.
